heading: Thread-model summary
text:
### Thread summary [RARC.6.6]

| Thread | What runs on it |
|---|---|
| Whichever thread calls an engine | That call, start to finish, and every callback it makes ([RARC.6.1.1], [RARC.6.5.1]). One call at a time per engine ([RARC.6.1.4]). |
| The integrator's other threads | I/O, bridging between engines, and whatever drives the clock ([RARC.6.4.1]). The engine owns no thread. |

---
